outcome: Clinical characteristics of Omicron infection during pregnancy
cohort: 93 confirmed cases of novel coronavirus infection and 109 non-infected patients admitted to the isolation ward of Guangdong Maternal and Child Health Hospital
finding: Omicron infection during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section, but there was no evidence of vertical transmission.
mod_finding: Both Omicron infection and gestational diabetes further increase the incidence of cesarean section
